* Speakers: 1
* Quality: x-low
* Samplerate: 22,050Hz

## Dataset

Synthetic speech dataset generated using the original es_MX-ald-medium Piper TTS model.

The dataset contains approximately 8 hours of audio generated from Spanish sentences obtained from the Tatoeba Project:
https://tatoeba.org/en/downloads

## Training

This model was trained from scratch using the synthetic dataset generated with the es_MX-ald-medium voice.

The goal of this model is to provide a smaller and faster alternative with fewer parameters.
